notes.30: A budget helps managers plan and control the business. Items 1 and 2 both related to control. Option 3 made no reference to either planning or control and should have been ignored, giving the key A.
notes.key_messages:
Candidates should identify any data which is irrelevant and ignore any options which use it.
Candidates need more familiarity with calculation of return on capital employed.
